name: Thue Fish Rewrite
aim: Polish: make the canvas fit the page, add a snack-eating sound, and a fish mood meter.

sessions.caption: First Thue toy: a fish swims to a rewrite rule and it fires. Three programs. Fish is bad at sorting, but it gets there.
Added fish snacks (click the sea to bribe the fish), a rule editor, and a Fish loop program that never ends and makes the fish sad.
